title: Section cohomology presheaf of a resolution complex
statement: For a scheme T [def-pc-scheme], a homological complex K [def-sp-injective-resolutions], of sheaves of modules on T, and q∈ℕ, define sectionCohomologyPresheaf(K,q) on T.Opensᵒᵖ by assigning to each open V the q-th homology of the cochain complex of sections of K over V; for an inclusion V≤W its map is the homology map induced by restriction of sections. Thus P(V) and its restriction maps are fixed objects, with no flatness or base-change data.

source.place: Tags 01E1 and 01E4; section-complex evaluation and restriction of injective resolutions (the declarations bundled in FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices).
